title: Facade codemods: retire the codemod-limit exception rows in the facade gate registry (protocol.ts, engine.ts, sql-driver.ts)
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgBDcBNVmSmo7VFHpj

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up that two reviews carried. The final contract review of PR #30030 (comment 6628808410) raised a should-fix: about 40 of the 60 exception rows in `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` cite #30020 (state-owning facets), but they are bodies because of codemod limits, not because of facet state. This seat's note on #30020 asked for an owner or a card, and none followed. The #30105 dev reports 25 more rows of the same kind for `sql-driver.ts` (PR #30139). ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p2. Route: `domain:devx`, the lane of the large-file split programme #29465.

Ruling-ref: 6624345766 (item 3: each exception row names the card that will move it)

## What is wrong

A facade-gate exception row must name the card that retires it. Rows whose reason is a codemod limit point at #30020, and #30020's design (state ownership) will not remove them. So either nothing retires them, or #30020 grows past its scope.

## The rows (reason → count; re-measure on `main`)

- `protocol.ts` + `engine.ts` (landed via #29998 / #30012):
  - inferred-return-type 16
  - static-reads-class 9
  - query-options erasure pin 6
  - closed-set 4
  - no-host-read 2
  - name-taken 1
  - host-entry-predicate 1
  - field-call 1
- `sql-driver.ts` (PR #30139, when it lands):
  - path-reader pin 9
  - accessor 5
  - knex field-call 4
  - inferred-return-type 4
  - computed parameter default 2
  - comment in parameters 1

## Wanted

- [ ] Re-point every codemod-limit row to this card, leaving state-owning rows on #30020.
- [ ] Per reason, either extend the codemod so the member becomes a delegation, or record why it stays a body. Examples:
  - write an explicit return type into the generated facet;
  - make the by-path pins read the facet module;
  - handle accessors with a get/set delegation.
- [ ] For each change: byte-identity of moved bodies, public `.d.ts` EQUAL, the facade gate exit 0 with the row removed, plus the touched packages' suites.

## Out of scope (⛔)

- State-owning bodies (#30020).
- Moving docblocks (#30053).

Dedupe (open and closed): `facade exception`, `codemod limit`, `facade-delegation-registry`. Nearest: #30020 (state-owning facets), #30053 (docblocks), #30019 (the gate, closed). **New.**
